summary: The plan has several correctness gaps that should be fixed before implementation: measurement mode cannot currently be passed to the shared student chrome as described, the dark Focus token re-scope misses variables already used by lesson/practice components, several proposed gate colors fail the stated contrast thresholds, and the baseball visual additions are not wired into real learning surfaces.

concerns.claim: The plan does not define a working data path for diagnostic measurement mode or muted rings to reach the shared student chrome, and it leaves the test reward firewall as caller intent rather than a hardcoded surface rule.
concerns.evidence: app/student/(shell)/layout.tsx:44 wraps every student route in `<AppShell displayName={displayName} workingAs={supabaseMode}>` and app/student/(shell)/layout.tsx:45 passes only `{children}`; app/student/(shell)/diagnostic/page.tsx:17 and app/student/(shell)/diagnostic/page.tsx:21 render `<DiagnosticFlow graphView=...>` with no route/shell props; new_plan/STYLE_GUIDE.md:211 says tests use the same progress instrument shown but inactive, and new_plan/STYLE_GUIDE.md:212 says `NO rings filling, points, streaks, correctness feedback, or bursts (firewall)`.
concerns.suggested_fix: Specify a concrete route-aware mechanism for `Chrome` mode/rings, such as a diagnostic route layout or client chrome that derives mode from the selected route segment. Also make the test firewall structural under `[data-surface="test"]` or an equivalent non-optional guard so reward/streak/fill components cannot appear because a caller forgot `mutedRings`.

concerns.claim: The Focus surface re-scope is incomplete for existing lesson/practice code, so wrapping those screens in `data-surface="focus"` can leave low-contrast accent, status, and feedback colors on the dark canvas.
concerns.evidence: app/globals.css:33 defines `--color-accent: #2a4878`, app/globals.css:47-52 define light-only `--color-success-bg`, `--color-error-bg`, `--color-error-bg-soft`, and `--color-error-ink`; app/student/(shell)/learn/[skillId]/LearnClient.tsx:81-86 uses `focus-visible:outline-accent`, `bg-accent`, and `hover:bg-accent-hover`; app/student/(shell)/practice/[skillId]/PracticeFlow.tsx:535-545 uses `--color-success-bg`, `--color-error-bg-soft`, and `text-error-ink`; app/student/(shell)/practice/[skillId]/PracticeFlow.tsx:550 and app/student/(shell)/practice/[skillId]/PracticeFlow.tsx:683-685 use `--color-error-ink` on feedback visuals.
concerns.suggested_fix: Expand the Focus re-scope to every semantic variable used by lesson/practice descendants: accent/accent-hover/accent-tint, status colors, success/error bg/border/ink, axis/grid colors, and focus outline colors. Then make the contrast audit scan actual token usages on Focus screens, not only the new planned pairings.

concerns.claim: Several colors listed as exact plan additions do not meet the plan’s own AA/non-text thresholds, so the phase gate is internally inconsistent unless alternatives are chosen up front.
concerns.evidence: Node REPL contrast calculation observed output: `#E5486D on #FFFFFF = 3.83`, `#168A4A on #FFFFFF = 4.40`, `#D97706 on #FFFFFF = 3.19`, `#9AA8BA on #FFFFFF = 2.42`, `#334155 on #0B0F17 = 1.85`, `#1E293B on #0B0F17 = 1.31`; new_plan/STYLE_GUIDE.md:80 says `--border-meaningful #9AA8BA` must be `>=3:1`; the plan’s §9 requires `action colors as text` and `meaningful borders >=3:1; raised-on-canvas >=3:1`.
concerns.suggested_fix: Do not label these as AA-verified exact additions. Pick darker on-light text colors, separate UI-only colors from text colors, use a darker/lighter meaningful border that actually reaches 3:1 on its surface, and clarify whether raised fill itself or its border must satisfy non-text contrast.

concerns.claim: The baseball-native visual plan adds optional components/props but does not wire them into the existing learning rendering path, so the acceptance item can pass in code while no real lesson/practice/diagnostic surface shows a strike-zone grid or stat panel.
concerns.evidence: components/learning/ProblemVisual.tsx:1 says `ProblemVisual` is the single source of truth mapping problem visuals, and components/learning/ProblemVisual.tsx:82 / components/learning/ProblemVisual.tsx:121 route coordinate specs to `<CoordinatePlane>`; components/learning/CoordinatePlane.tsx:53-86 lists current props and has no `strikeZone`; repo search observed output for `rg -n -- "CoordinatePlane|strikeZone|StatPanel|ProblemVisual" components app` shows CoordinatePlane usage in dev gallery and via ProblemVisual, but no `strikeZone` or `StatPanel` call sites.
concerns.suggested_fix: Define how item visual metadata selects baseball mode, pass `strikeZone` through `ProblemVisual` into `CoordinatePlane`, and add at least one real lesson/practice fixture or seeded visual that renders the stat panel/strike-zone path. Keep the prop off by default only if the plan also identifies the call sites that turn it on.
